items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.why: Will not travel; groin for Montgomery.
items.implication: Full backfield snaps to Woody Marks (handled 98% last week post-Montgomery exit).
items.opportunity: Marks every-down RB role and all touches vs JAX.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers (and indefinitely) after follow-up ultrasound showed movement in superficial blood clot in calf; Tanner McKee expected to start. Full team statement details timeline from cleat injury in Week 4.
items.why: Movement in superficial blood clot detected Wednesday night ultrasound; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense without dual-threat QB; check TE/RB/WR usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume potential for Goedert/Smith/Wicks if McKee airs it out.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return TNF due to shoulder, then returned to the game and active.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.
items.implication: Full or near-full role post-return vs SEA.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle WR28 this week on usage/matchup.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight day Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Questionable or worse for Week 6; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, other Bills WRs elevated targets.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Availability in doubt; monitor for role vs LAR.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other ARI RBs (or Brissett checkdown) benefit.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.why: Hamstring; team hopeful but needs practices.
items.implication: Game-time or questionable; backups Shipley (foot) limited options.
items.opportunity: If OUT, committee or Pierce/Steele elevated.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring.
items.implication: Likely limited or OUT; Worthy/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy target share bump if Rice sits.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially DNP again Thursday (ankle).
items.why: Ankle; coach notes better but needs reps.
items.implication: Questionable for Week 6 vs CLE; monitor.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Huntley or backup; Flowers/Andrews still viable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons.
items.why: Full practice Wed/Thu after hamstring tear.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks him WR4 for Week 6. All-in on volume/matchup with Samuel out multi-week.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers; Evans 36% target share last week, higher without Deebo.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (WR28) vs SEA on poor recent usage (most yards in one game). Fact: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week high ankle; Rhamondre Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches in prior absence, avg 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches. LOVE Stevenson RB9.
items.why: Waddle yards concentrated; Stevenson volume spike confirmed historically.
items.implication: Sit Waddle; start/upgrade Stevenson as workhorse.
items.conflict: Waddle returned ACTIVE but usage still questionable.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty says feeling great, best he's felt this season.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries vs BUF or upcoming.

items.text: 49ers opened practice window for WR Christian Kirk (IR, calf all season).
items.implication: Potential return in 21 days max; depth for SF WRs.
items.opportunity: If activated soon, competes with Aiyuk/etc but short-term limited.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Saquon Barkley turns 30 in Feb; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Worth risk moving year early vs late.
items.why: Age curve + Eagles precedent; contender need.
items.implication: Sell-high window in dynasty/redraft if offers come; monitor injury.
items.opportunity: Trade value still high despite age/hamstring.
